protocol.scope: Fresh static nonlinear FEM objects; six reset pokes, a second calibrated view of the initial load, or stop. Assumed costs: view 0.25, poke 1; loss is posterior mean coordinate variance plus 0.01 mm^2 per cost unit. Myopic two-action horizon. Synthetic fiducials and known rest geometry. No dynamic or real-hardware claim.

calibration: Separate object-max split-conformal scale for each policy and budget; 24 calibration objects, 3 repeats, 243 coordinates; rank 23/24 for nominal 90%. Policy fixed before calibration. No uniform per-layout or physical-parameter guarantee.

fixed.scope: Saved histories only; policy selected on 33^3 per layout, predictions and calibration on 65^3. Does not establish action convergence.

random.scope: Saved histories only; policy selected on 33^3 per layout, predictions and calibration on 65^3. Does not establish action convergence.

adaptive_pokes.scope: Saved histories only; policy selected on 33^3 per layout, predictions and calibration on 65^3. Does not establish action convergence.

cost_aware.scope: Saved histories only; policy selected on 33^3 per layout, predictions and calibration on 65^3. Does not establish action convergence.

reference_qualification.scope: Sampled displacement, equilibrium, positive Jacobian, spatial and quadrature refinement. Strain and traction are not fully qualified.

legacy_initial.scope: Frozen v06 model and band multiplier on fresh objects; different development/calibration data than v07, so an end-to-end comparison, not an isolated covariance ablation.

action_refinement.scope: First six test objects, first noise repeat; 33-to-65 cubed per-layout quadrature at identical 128 outcome samples. Evaluates saved histories, never substitutes refined actions. Not a full action or outcome-sampling convergence proof.

prediction_refinement.scope: Post-hoc saved-history prediction audit, 65 to 97 cubed per layout. Calibration multipliers and selected actions unchanged; primary results stay on 65. No policy retuning.
